manifest.name: dsh-todo-progress-guard
manifest.description: DSH host plugin that keeps todo_write progress in sync: it nudges the agent mid-turn and completes stranded tasks when a turn finishes normally.
manifest.author: DoubleChess

bundle.text:
# Bundle patch for dsh-todo-progress-guard.
#
# The row id is stable; `name` must equal this package's `name` so the Loader
# resolves the module from the profile's node_modules. Override `config` from a
# later patch layer (the profile's own cordis.patch.yml) to tune the thresholds.
- insert:
    - id: todo-progress-guard
      name: 'dsh-todo-progress-guard'
      config:
        # Remind after this many model steps without a todo_write.
        stepThreshold: 2
        # Remind after this many other tool calls without a todo_write.
        callThreshold: 5
        # Complete leftover in_progress/pending items when a turn finishes normally.
        autoCompleteOnTurnEnd: true

readme.text:
English | [中文](https://github.com/LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md)

[](https://github.com/LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

Gives the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) todo list a way to advance on its own: it nudges the model to
refresh `todo_write` during multi-step tool work, and completes stranded tasks when a turn ends
normally.

---

1. **Frozen mid-turn** — the model writes a plan once, then runs dozens of `bash` / `read` / `edit`
   calls while its attention stays on tool output. The panel keeps showing the first item as
   `in_progress` for the rest of the turn.
2. **Stuck after the answer** — the model finishes the work and answers in a step with no tool
   calls, so it never gets to send one last `todo_write`. The turn is over and the panel still
   reads `1 in progress · N pending`.

This bundle closes both gaps with one Host-side Cordis plugin. It changes no DSH core package and
invents no new session event types.

When the current turn owns an **incomplete** todo list and the model spends several steps or tool
calls without calling `todo_write`, the plugin injects one context message
(`source.kind = "todo-progress-reminder"`, `form: "notice"`, rendered as a collapsible injected row
in the chat stream) after the **last** tool result of that step.

The body repeats the current list verbatim, because `todo_write` replaces the whole list — the model
can copy it forward without re-reading distant history:

```text
Task progress reminder (1/3 completed; 2 step(s) / 4 tool call(s) since the last todo_write):
1. [completed] Recon the repository
2. [in_progress] Implement the fix
3. [pending] Run the test suite

As a turn **ends normally** — before `turn/end` is written, while the turn is still legitimately
open — any leftover `in_progress` / `pending` items are written back as `completed` through one final
`todo/write` snapshot. The panel can never outlive the work it describes.

**The Web UI is the recommended path**: open **Plugins → Install** and paste any spec below.
It adds the dependency *and* selects the bundle, so the patch applies immediately with no restart:

```text
github:LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard   # straight from GitHub (this repository)
/absolute/path/to/dsh-todo-progress-guard        # a local checkout; edits take effect immediately
dsh-todo-progress-guard                          # from npm once published
```

**The CLI only installs the package** (`dsh plugin` is a pnpm passthrough and does not select bundles):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard
```

After that, enable `dsh-todo-progress-guard` once in the Plugins page (equivalent to adding it to
`dsh.profile.bundles` in `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json`); only then is the bundle's
`cordis.patch.yml` applied.

Defaults are usable as-is. To tune them, override this row's `config` by id in the profile's own
`cordis.patch.yml` (a patch layer replaces `config` wholesale, so restate all three keys):

```yaml
- id: todo-progress-guard
  config:
    stepThreshold: 2
    callThreshold: 5

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `stepThreshold` | `2` | Remind after this many model steps without a `todo_write` |
| `callThreshold` | `5` | Remind after this many other tool calls without a `todo_write` (needs at least one step) |
| `autoCompleteOnTurnEnd` | `true` | Complete leftover items when a turn ends normally |

The two thresholds are OR-ed: whichever is reached first reminds. At most one reminder per step, and
counters reset at every turn boundary. Invalid values (non-positive integers, non-booleans) fall back
to the defaults instead of failing activation.
Completion only happens when the turn really did work. The plugin appends nothing when:

The plugin only **appends** `todo/write` events, never rewrites history, and always writes inside a
legitimately open turn, so it stays compatible with the durable-log invariants owned by
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo`.

- Requires the Host `sessions` and `sessionProjections` services; the plugin stays inactive where
  they are absent (plain `inject` semantics) instead of failing the composition.
- Verified on DSH `0.2.0-rc.2`. Every extension point it uses — `additionalContexts` on
  `tools/post-execute`, `agent/turn-stopping`, and the `todos` projection — is public contract there.
- **Zero runtime dependencies**: the plugin imports no DSH package, so a `link:` checkout and a
  registry install behave identically. (Exporting a Schemastery `Config` would break `link:`
  installs, because a symlinked realpath cannot resolve DSH packages; configuration is therefore
  validated inside the plugin.)

```bash
npm test        # node --test; 13 cases cover reminders, completion and every boundary
```

The tests drive the real plugin code through a minimal Host stand-in (session log + `todos`
projection + tool waterfall) and import nothing from DSH.

[](https://github.com/LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard/actions/workflows/ci.yml)

给 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的任务清单补上「自动推进」：在多步工具调用过程中提醒模型更新
`todo_write`，并在正常结束一轮对话时把遗留任务收尾为已完成。

---
本插件用一个 Host 侧 Cordis 插件同时补上这两个缺口，**不改动 DSH 核心包，也不写新的事件类型**。

当当前轮次已经有一份**未完成**的任务清单，而模型连续若干步/若干次工具调用都没调用
`todo_write` 时，插件会在该步骤**最后一个工具结果之后**注入一条
`user/message` 形式的上下文提醒（`source.kind = "todo-progress-reminder"`，
`form: "notice"`，在聊天流里渲染成一条可折叠的注入提示）。

提醒正文会把当前清单**逐条原文列出**，因为 `todo_write` 要求整表重发——这样模型无需翻找
几十步之前的历史就能直接复制更新：

```text
Task progress reminder (1/3 completed; 2 step(s) / 4 tool call(s) since the last todo_write):
1. [completed] Recon the repository
2. [in_progress] Implement the fix
3. [pending] Run the test suite

一轮对话**正常结束**的那一刻（`turn/end` 写入之前、轮次仍处于合法开放状态），如果清单里
还残留 `in_progress` / `pending`，插件会追加一条最终的 `todo/write` 快照，把它们统一收尾为
`completed`。这样面板状态永远不会比它描述的工作活得更久。

**推荐走 Web 界面**：打开 **插件 → 安装**，粘贴下面任意一个 spec。
它会同时完成「装依赖」和「启用该 bundle」，patch 立即生效，不用重启：

```text
github:LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard   # 直接从 GitHub（本仓库）
/absolute/path/to/dsh-todo-progress-guard        # 本机目录，开发时改动即时生效
dsh-todo-progress-guard                          # 发布到 npm 之后
```

**命令行只负责装包**（`dsh plugin` 是 pnpm 的透传，不做 bundle 选择）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LaochenFEIZHAI/dsh-todo-progress-guard
```

装完后还要在「插件」页把 `dsh-todo-progress-guard` 启用一次（等价于把它加进
`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`），bundle 的
`cordis.patch.yml` 才会被应用。

默认值即可直接使用；需要调整时，在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里按 id 覆盖这一行的
`config`（patch 层会整份替换 `config`，所以要把三个键都写上）：

```yaml
- id: todo-progress-guard
  config:
    stepThreshold: 2
    callThreshold: 5

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `stepThreshold` | `2` | 距离上次 `todo_write` 经过多少个模型步骤后提醒 |
| `callThreshold` | `5` | 距离上次 `todo_write` 累计多少次其他工具调用后提醒（需至少跨过 1 步） |
| `autoCompleteOnTurnEnd` | `true` | 轮次正常结束时是否把遗留任务收尾为 `completed` |

两个阈值是「或」关系：先到先提醒。同一步骤内最多提醒一次；每轮次开始时计数清零。
非法值（非正整数、非布尔）会被忽略并回退到默认值，插件不会因此加载失败。

收尾只在一轮**确实做完事**时发生。以下任一情况插件都不写任何东西：

- 当前轮次已被用户中断（`signal.aborted`），或最后一次助手消息被打断；
- 还有排队中的下一步（`agent.inbox.nextStep` 非空）——那说明轮次没结束；
- 本步骤调用过 `ask_user_question` 或 `exit_plan_mode`（正在等人类回答，不能替用户判定完成）；
- 清单已全部 `completed`（无事可做）；
- 清单是刚建好、还没执行过任何其他工具的「纯计划」（这是意图，不是成果）。

插件只**追加** `todo/write` 事件，不改写历史；写入始终发生在合法的开放轮次内，因此与
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo` 自带的持久日志不变式兼容。

- 需要 Host 暴露 `sessions` 与 `sessionProjections` 服务；缺失时插件不激活（`inject` 语义），
  不会影响其他插件。
- 已在 DSH `0.2.0-rc.2` 上验证；依赖的扩展点（`tools/post-execute` 的 `additionalContexts`、
  `agent/turn-stopping`、`todos` 投影）均属于该版本的公开契约。
- **零运行时依赖**：插件不 import 任何 DSH 包，因此 `link:` 本地目录安装和 registry 安装行为
  完全一致（若导出 Schemastery `Config`，`link:` 安装会因真实路径解析不到 DSH 包而加载失败，
  所以配置改为插件内部校验）。

```bash
npm test        # node --test，13 个用例覆盖提醒/收尾/边界
```

测试用一套最小的 Host 替身（会话事件日志 + `todos` 投影 + 工具 waterfall）驱动真实插件代码，
不使用任何 DSH 内部模块。
